name: vendor.openwop-app.document-editor.agents
description: Writing Assistant for the rich-text document editor (canvas.document). Rewrites or answers about the text the user quotes into the EXISTING chat; it has no tools and writes nothing. The user applies a reply back to the document as a tracked suggestion they accept or reject. Pure-agent pack (ADR 1055 D4).
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Writing Assistant
agents.description: Rewrites a passage the user quotes from a rich-text document, or answers a question about the document text they paste. Has no tools: it never saves or changes anything; the user applies a reply as a tracked suggestion.
